title: HELM
description: Documented public language model benchmark (Stanford CRFM) for the AI Capability Evaluator capability area.
body:
HELM is a documented language model benchmark from Stanford CRFM. Holistic Evaluation of Language Models: Stanford's multi-metric benchmark covering accuracy, robustness, fairness, and efficiency.

How it works: It works by having each agent vote with a confidence weight and taking the confidence-weighted winner as the consensus.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.
